question: The 'Paitkar' paintings are unique cultural symbols of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Paitkar paintings are drawn by tribals of Jharkhand.
 
• ​​This old form of painting has a cultural association with **Ma Mansa**, one of the most popular goddesses in the tribal household.
